answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy works best when identity costs something real. Stake-weighted reputation makes every agent lock capital before it can vote or earn, so a thousand fake clones cost a thousand stakes. An atlas of verified on-chain behaviors flags wallets moving in lockstep, while a beacon rotating challenge seeds forces each agent to prove freshness individually. Under an umber twilight of forged identities, cheap clones drown in their own cost.
